# A paper bit: a flat cream square 0.16 m (unlit), the game throws a pool of them out of a chute
# after a good sort. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Bit --base-color 0.9647 0.9059 0.6118 --no-slot --emission 0.9647 0.9059 0.6118
add mesh cube --name Bit --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.000 0.000
scale 0.160 0.160 0.060
apply --scale
material assign Bit
set rotation 30 20 10
shade flat
export confetti.glb
